title: PSL撬动五倍杠杆：8000亿已部署，六网建设资金放大后谁来承接？
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: And where do you see the space to finance this operation? Ramping up fiscal spending, how is it going to look like?
segments.zh: 你认为这项行动的资金空间在哪里？财政支出加码会是什么样子？

segments.en: It probably has to be a combination of many things, but I was most instinctively from the central government borrowing. Or central government owned SOE related borrowing.
segments.zh: 可能需要多种方式组合，但我最直觉的判断是来自中央政府融资，或央企国企相关融资。

segments.en: So if we're talking about, for example, the recent PSL, one of the monitor policy tools that the PBOC has recently mentioned last week regarding the easing measures,
segments.zh: 比如最近的PSL，这是央行上周在宽松措施中提到的货币政策工具之一。

segments.en: essentially such structural lending tools can be effectively getting more money into policy banks and policy banks make the lending into a specific project to support the six networks.
segments.zh: 这类结构性借贷工具能有效将更多资金注入政策性银行，再由政策性银行放贷给具体项目，支持六网建设。

segments.en: And once this money comes into their account, this would be seen as equity rather than credit, who are loans.
segments.zh: 一旦这笔资金进入账户，它会被视为权益而非信贷或贷款。

segments.en: And therefore, they would be able to use this amount to, for example, the 800 billion that we mentioned in August, and that has been deployed would be multiplied by many times because commercial banks seeing that as the equity would be able to come with matching loans.
segments.zh: 因此，他们可以用这笔资金，比如8月提到的8000亿元已部署资金，会被放大数倍，因为商业银行看到权益后能提供配套贷款。

segments.en: That is four to five or five to six times more. So beyond just maybe covering for that shortfall in investment, how do you see this billing out to the rest of the economy?
segments.zh: 也就是四到五倍甚至五到六倍。那么除了弥补配置缺口，你认为这会如何传导到整体经济？
